reason: Both are US building-products manufacturers selling through distributors to contractors. Carlisle focuses on roofing, waterproofing and insulation (building envelope). CSW sells HVAC/R, plumbing and electrical accessories, architectural and firestopping products, and specialty lubricants. The product overlap is only at the edges: building components, sealants, and Carlisle's HVAC brands. Customers overlap in the trades and distributors, but CSW's core buyers are HVAC, plumbing and electrical contractors and industrial users, not roofing contractors.
